 Eagles sign OL Evan Neal 
 By
 Charean Williams , 
 By
 Charean Williams 
     Published October 22, 2026 04:04 PM 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 Email
 The Eagles have signed offensive lineman Evan Neal, according to multiple reports. He presumably will join the practice squad.
 Neal practiced with the team Thursday. 
 The Raiders cut Neal from their practice squad earlier in the week. 
 The Giants released Neal out of the preseason, and the Raiders signed him soon after.
 Neal was not active for any games with the Raiders, and he has not played in a game since 2024.
 The Giants selected him seventh overall in the 2022 draft, and he began his career at right tackle. The Giants moved him to right guard, and he did not play a snap there last season.
 He ended his Giants career with 29 games played, including 27 starts.
